newsitem.title: PANAMA: DHL LatAm carrier begins operations.
newsitem.headline: DHL LatAm carrier begins operations.

text.p: DHL International Ltd said that its new DHL Aero Expreso joint venture airline has inaugurated Miami-Panama City service for the global express giant.

DHL Aero Expresso uses B-727-200 freighters. The new carrier will build a Latin American network for DHL Worldwide Express from its Panama City base, eventually serving 32 destinations throughout Central and South America and the Caribbean, DHL said in a statement.
Initially, the new service will operate between Miami and Panama City five times weekly, the statement said.

The new air network and hub are part of a $30 million investment by DHL International to expand its Latin American infrastructure and regional product line. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
